articles.title: Pope Leo asks Syro-Malankara faithful in Europe to keep their traditions alive
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV has urged Syro-Malankara faithful residing in Europe to actively preserve their distinct cultural and religious traditions. For SSB aspirants, understanding such calls highlights the role of international religious leaders in fostering cultural continuity and managing diaspora communities worldwide.
